newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Earthquake shakes Croatian coast -- radio.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake shakes Croatian coast -- radio.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.0 on the Richter scale shook the Croatian coast on Thursday night, Bosnian state radio reported.
A seismologist in the Croatian capital of Zagreb said the tremor occurred at 10.45 p.m. (0845) near the Adriatic resort of Dubrovnik, the radio said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
A receptionist at the Hotel Lapad in Dubrovnik said guests were frightened by the size of the tremor.
"People were panicking and running out of the building but everyone is begining to calm down now," he told Reuters by telephone.
The tremor could be felt 400 km (250 miles) to the north in Zagreb and in the Bosnian capital Sarajevo.
